text:
sana: quick sync request — we need a small alignment on how errors are exposed to clients vs what we show in the console. routing + quota edgecases are tripping customers in canaries.

michael: +1. Are we talking the thin HTTP status + header approach or richer JSON body for hosted API?

sana: both. idea: minimal surface for low-priv clients (HTTP 429/503 + `Retry-After`/`x-rw-hint`) and richer structured body for SDKs/console consumers. dispute is around semantics for quota vs transient overload.

alex: my concern — too many code variants. Would prefer canonical `status_bucket` labels: `transient`, `quota`, `terminal`, `degraded`. Client gets an opaque code but console gets expanded reason and rollout flags.

tara: from UX — console badges should map 1:1 to `status_bucket`. Example: `quota` => orange "Quota hit", `transient` => yellow "Retryable". Keep user-facing copy short.

jordan: telemetry: we must emit `client_exposure` boolean and `status_bucket` in trace/span attributes. That makes sampling & alerting straightforward. Also tag `rollout_phase` (canary/gradual/ga).

michael: example error body proposal for SDKs: ```json
{
  "code": "rw.quota.exceeded",
  "status_bucket": "quota",
  "message": "Tenant monthly token budget reached",
  "retryable": false,
  "hints": ["consider reserved capacity", "contact support"],
  "expose_to_client": true
}
```

alex: +1 to structure. But for plain HTTP clients we should avoid leaking `expose_to_client` — that is internal. Instead rely on `x-rw-hint` header: `x-rw-hint: quota;plan=dedicated`.

sana: decision proposal: 1) canonical `status_bucket` values (transient/quota/terminal/degraded); 2) SDKs get full structured body; 3) HTTP minimal: status code + `x-rw-hint` + short message; 4) console gets rich expansion and rollout context.

tara: phrasing suggestions for console: short line + tooltip. e.g. badge: "Quota — tokens exhausted" tooltip: "Tenant hit monthly budget. Suggest reserved capacity or burst buy". Keep language actionable.

jordan: telemetry counters to add: `errors.by_bucket`, `errors.client_exposed`, `errors.rollout_phase`. Also record `latency_at_failure` to correlate.

michael: rollout nuance — for canary we should set `expose_to_client: false` for new bucket refinements so external apps don't rely on changing codes. We'll only flip to true after GA. Add a server-side feature flag `err.expose_mode`.

sana: agreed. action items: @michael implement header + minimal http mapping PR, @alex add `status_bucket` to trace schema, @tara draft console badge copy, @jordan add telemetry metrics. I'll coordinate opt-in for canary in the rollout doc.
